Novato 国际青少年民间舞蹈节: Novato International Youth Folk Dance Festival
社区活动免费 · 餐饮另购: Free community event · Food sold separately
Minoan Dancers 邀请湾区家庭观看不同传统的青少年舞蹈演出，并参加亲: Minoan Dancers welcomes Bay Area families to youth performances celebrating different folk traditions, with hands-on activities and Greek food for sale. A relaxed Sunday outing for meeting local communities.
活动于 11:30 开始；在主办方网页登记同行人数，帮助准备儿童手工材料。: The festival starts at 11:30am. Register your group size on the organizer’s page to help with supplies for children’s activities.
表演及社区活动免费，gyros、spanakopita、baklava 等餐食另: Performances and community activities are free. Gyros, spanakopita, baklava and other food are sold separately; budget for meals as needed.
编辑建议带孩子先看一段舞蹈，再参加手工；官方未公布结束时间，返程前再看当日通知。: Editor tip: alternate a performance with hands-on activities. No end time is published; check the day’s updates when planning your return.
Santa Rosa 公园南瓜寻宝: Santa Rosa Pumpkins in the Parks Scavenger Hunt
10 月 1–30 日 · 公园日出至日落开放: Oct 1–30 · Parks open sunrise to sunset
寻宝免费 · 找到后须由成人陪同领奖: Free scavenger hunt · Adult required for prize pickup
在指定市立公园寻找隐藏的南瓜卡片，把日常散步变成亲子寻宝。找到后按背面说明去 F: Look for hidden pumpkin cards in participating city parks and turn a neighborhood walk into a family scavenger hunt. Follow the card’s instructions to collect a prize at Finley Community Center.
先从官网选择参与公园；仅在公园日出至日落的开放时间寻找，不能把全市任意公园都当作: Choose a participating park from the official list and search only during sunrise-to-sunset park hours. Not every city park is included.
南瓜卡片会重新藏放至 10 月 23 日；10 月 30 日为最后领奖日，月底前: Staff re-hide cards through October 23. October 30 is the last prize-collection day; cards may be harder to find late in the month.
领奖地点为 Finley Community Center 前台，周一至周五 0: Collect prizes at the Finley Community Center front desk Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm, with an adult present. A weekend find requires a separate weekday visit.
Litquake Out Loud 与独立出版书市: Litquake Out Loud & Small Press Book Fair
湾区有色人种与 LGBTQ+ 写作者带来户外文学活动，同场有独立出版社书市和现场: Bay Area BIPOC and LGBTQ+ writers present outdoor literary events alongside a small-press book fair and live music. Browse local publishers, listen to readings or stop by for a shorter visit.
到 Yerba Buena Gardens 的 Esplanade 舞台区域，活: Head to the Esplanade stage at Yerba Buena Gardens between 11am and 4pm. This is a separate event from other Litquake programs that month.
可通过主办方免费登记，现场参与不以登记为前提；买书另行支付。: You can register free through the organizer, but registration is not required. Book purchases cost extra.
编辑建议带外套和装书的袋子；详细策展人与音乐名单仍待公布，出发前看官方更新。: Editor tip: bring a layer and a book bag. Detailed curator and music lineups are still to be announced; check official updates before leaving.
Novato Nostalgia Days 经典车展: Novato Nostalgia Days Classic Car Show
观众入场免费 · 餐饮购物另付: Free spectator admission · Food and purchases extra
Downtown Novato 的 Grant Avenue 变成经典车、改装车: Downtown Novato’s Grant Avenue fills with classic and custom vehicles plus live music. Plan a relaxed Marin half-day with older relatives or let children pick their favorite cars.
本条收录 10 月 10 日白天车展，开放 10:00–16:00；10 月 9: This listing covers the October 10 daytime show, 10am–4pm. A separate cruise takes place on October 9 with different hours.
免费参观车辆，现场餐饮、摊位消费及参展车辆报名另算；不要把免费观众入场理解成免费: Spectator admission is free. Food, purchases and vehicle registration are separate; a free visit does not include entering a car.
编辑建议按 Grant Avenue 步行路线安排集合点；现场音乐后可留到 15: Editor tip: choose a meeting point along Grant Avenue. Stay for the 3:30pm awards if interested and allow time to leave after the show.
图书馆免费活动 · 限 0–6 岁儿童与照护者: Free library program · Children ages 0–6 with a caregiver
Jamie Gao 用普通话与英语带孩子听故事，把语言练习和想象力放进周六上午。: Jamie Gao brings Mandarin and English storytelling to a Saturday morning, combining language practice with imagination. A local option for Peninsula families seeking Chinese-language activities.
10 月 10 日 11:00 到主图书馆儿童室；不要把活动地点误认成 East: Go to the Main Library Children’s Room at 11am on October 10, rather than the Easton branch.
面向 0–6 岁儿童及照护者；未带儿童的成人不能参加，请按年龄选择家庭成员。: The session is for children ages 0–6 and their caregivers. Adults without children are not admitted.
编辑建议稍早到馆找好座位，结束后让孩子选一本双语绘本；借书需要适用的图书证。: Editor tip: arrive a little early and choose a bilingual picture book afterward. Borrowing requires an accepted library card.
在 Piedmont Park 主草坪看《Wonka》，把东湾周五晚安排成低预算: Watch Wonka on Piedmont Park’s main lawn for an inexpensive East Bay Friday night. The city welcomes everyone, with the film starting after sunset.
市府列出的 2026 年开场时间为 18:40，实际随日落；建议提前到主草坪选位: The city lists a 6:40pm start for 2026, subject to sunset. Arrive early to find a spot on the main lawn.
自带毯子或低矮沙滩椅，不需要为本场电影购买门票。: Bring a blanket or low beach chair. Admission to this screening is free.
编辑建议备好保暖层，把随身物品集中放好；回程经过住宅区时降低音量。: Editor tip: pack warm layers and keep belongings together. Be considerate of nearby homes when leaving.
街区入场免费 · 酒饮、餐食与儿童项目另付: Free admission · Drinks, food and children’s attractions extra
Campbell 历史街区集合手工艺摊位、多个音乐舞台、德式餐食和社区演出。免费: Historic Downtown Campbell hosts artisan stalls, multiple music stages, German food and community performances. Free admission makes it easy for families to browse and enjoy music, with purchases optional.
周六 10:00–18:00，周日 10:00–17:00；先选一天，按官方节目: Open Saturday 10am–6pm and Sunday 10am–5pm. Choose a day and use the official schedule to pick your stages.
免费入场不包括饮品、杯具、Kinderplatz 儿童项目或部分比赛；需要时从官: Free admission excludes drinks, glassware, Kinderplatz attractions and some contests. Buy any required tickets through the official links.
编辑建议白天带孩子逛手工摊位、休息后再听音乐；品酒同行者提前安排回程交通。: Editor tip: browse artisan stalls with children before taking a break for music. Anyone drinking should arrange a ride home in advance.
社区节庆免费 · 餐车消费另付: Free community festival · Food-truck purchases extra
Cedar Rose Park 的秋季社区节庆有现场音乐、种子交换、食物比赛与儿: Cedar Rose Park’s fall community celebration brings live music, a seed swap, food contests and children’s activities together. A neighborhood outing for East Bay families.
11:00–16:00 到 Cedar Rose Park；市府提供免费自行车寄: Visit Cedar Rose Park from 11am–4pm. The city offers free bike valet; AC Transit Route 52 and a walk from North Berkeley BART are other options.
带毯子或草地椅听音乐；餐车餐饮自费，参与种子交换前先看官方当天安排。: Bring a blanket or lawn chair for the music. Food trucks charge separately; check the day’s details before joining the seed swap.
如参加食物比赛，09:00–11:30 送交作品、12:00 评审；志愿者须提前: Food-contest entries are accepted 9am–11:30am, with judging at noon. Volunteers must register in advance; no same-day volunteer signups.
Emeryville 年度艺术展闭幕周末: Emeryville Annual Art Exhibition: Closing Weekend
第 40 届 Emeryville 年度艺术展在 Public Market 举: The 40th Annual Emeryville Art Exhibition is at Public Market. This listing highlights its last three open days, an easy local-art outing to combine with a nearby meal.
闭幕周末 10 月 23–25 日均为 11:00–18:00，地址是 5905: The closing weekend runs October 23–25, 11am–6pm each day, at 5905 Shellmound Street.
全展期其实为 10 月 3–25 日、每周三至周日；若想提前去，周一与周二不要按: The full exhibition runs October 3–25, Wednesdays–Sundays. If visiting earlier, do not plan on Monday or Tuesday opening.
编辑建议先看主办方艺术家名单，留一小时慢慢逛；购餐与停车按现场规则另行安排。: Editor tip: browse the organizer’s artist list first and allow an hour for the art. Arrange food and parking separately.
免费社区活动 · 从官方链接登记: Free community event · Register through the official link
Family Connections 在 Portola 社区中心举办手工、游戏: Family Connections hosts crafts, games, snacks and prizes at its Portola center, with costumes encouraged. A neighborhood gathering for families after school.
16:30–18:00 到 2565 San Bruno Avenue 的 Po: Visit the Portola center at 2565 San Bruno Avenue, 4:30–6pm, rather than the Excelsior center on Mission Street.
活动免费；从机构网页进入报名链接，确认当时的登记与名额信息。: The event is free. Follow the organization’s registration link to check current signup and availability details.
编辑建议选择方便做手工和走动的服装；零食种类未公布，有饮食需求先向机构确认。: Editor tip: choose a costume that allows easy crafting and movement. Snack details are not published; ask the organization about dietary needs.
免费 · 必须预先登记，名额有限: Free · Advance registration required; limited spaces
Keiser Park 的四分之一英里讨糖步道由装饰摊点串起，为 12 岁以下儿: Keiser Park’s quarter-mile decorated trail is designed for children under 12 and adult chaperones. A short daytime option for North Bay families.
Windsor 居民 9 月 15 日 10:00 开放登记，非居民 9 月 1: Windsor residents can register September 15 at 10am; nonresidents September 16 at 10am. Reservations are required even though admission is free.
注册前在儿童休闲活动账户签好 waiver，并核对所选入场时段；活动范围为 12: Complete the waiver in the child’s recreation account before registering and check your chosen entry slot. The event runs noon–4pm.
儿童全程须由成人看护；编辑建议带轻便糖袋及适合走短步道的鞋。: Adults must supervise children throughout. Editor tip: bring a light treat bag and shoes suitable for a short trail.
基础票 $7 · 豪华票 $25，须选签到时段: Basic pass $7 · Deluxe pass $25; choose a check-in slot
12 岁及以下儿童可以在公园讨糖，并参加 Fun Zone 的手工、脸部彩绘等项: Children ages 12 and under can trick-or-treat and enjoy Fun Zone activities. Families wanting a train, carousel and pony ride can choose a deluxe pass with the listed rides included.
通过市府购票页面选择一个签到时段，最早 11:30、最后一组 14:00–14:: Choose a check-in slot through the city’s ticket page. The first starts at 11:30am and the last is 2–2:30pm; check-in windows are not the event’s full hours.
$7 基础票含讨糖和 Fun Zone；$25 豪华票另含火车、旋转木马及一圈小: The $7 basic pass covers trick-or-treating and the Fun Zone. The $25 deluxe pass adds a train ride, carousel ride and one-lap pony ride, with two adult companions on the train and carousel; extra adults pay separately.
票于 7 月 30 日开售且可能售罄；雨天早晨看市府 Facebook 或致电: Pass sales opened July 30 and may sell out. In rainy weather, check the city’s Facebook page or call 707-543-3425 on the event morning.
Benicia 周四农贸市场季末场: Benicia Thursday Farmers Market: Season Finale
食材、餐饮与商品按摊位收费: Produce, food and goods priced by vendors
Benicia Main Street 公布的 2026 周四农贸市场季到 10: Benicia Main Street’s 2026 Thursday farmers-market season ends October 29. Shop for seasonal produce and artisan goods after work and enjoy the historic Solano County waterfront.
本条收录 10 月 29 日季末场；9–10 月周四市场为 16:00–19:0: This listing is for the October 29 season finale. September–October Thursday hours are 4–7pm, earlier than the summer 8pm close.
购物与餐食按各摊位价格购买；先看当日摊位，再决定需要现金还是电子支付。: Produce and meals are bought at each vendor’s prices. Check the stalls’ payment options before choosing cash or electronic payment.
编辑建议带购物袋并先买需要的食材，再安排滨水散步；天气或摊位调整以主办方当天公告: Editor tip: bring shopping bags and buy essential groceries before a waterfront walk. Check same-day organizer updates for weather or vendor changes.
San José Avenida de Altares 亡灵节文化夜: San José Avenida de Altares Día de los Muertos
Mexican Heritage Plaza 第十届 Avenida de Al: Mexican Heritage Plaza’s 10th Avenida de Altares celebrates Día de los Muertos through community altars, family art activities and an artisan market. Spend the evening exploring East San José’s traditions of remembrance and creativity.
10 月 31 日 17:30–22:30，地址为 1700 Alum Rock: The event runs October 31, 5:30–10:30pm, at 1700 Alum Rock Avenue. Admission is free; vendor purchases are separate.
主要活动在户外，部分项目在室内；编辑建议为孩子准备外套，并先逛祭坛与手工区。: Most activities are outdoors, with selected indoor programs. Editor tip: bring layers for children and begin with the altars and art activities.
现场表演名单仍待公布；出发前看主办方更新，拍摄祭坛或参与者时先尊重现场说明与意愿: The performance lineup is still to be announced. Check organizer updates and respect posted guidance and people’s wishes when photographing altars or participants.
